pretreatments.description: Freezing/thawing technique: samples frozen at -20 °C or -80 °C for 48 h and subsequently thawed for 24 h at 6 °C.

Chemical alkaline treatment with NaOH: soaking fresh GP in chemical agent concentrations of 6% and 10% w/w dry basis at ambient temperature (20 ± 1 °C) for 24 h with continuous shaking at 150 rpm, followed by neutralization to pH 7.5.

Chemical alkaline treatment with NH3: soaking fresh GP in chemical agent concentrations of 6% and 10% w/w dry basis at ambient temperature (20 ± 1 °C) for 24 h with continuous shaking at 150 rpm, followed by neutralization to pH 7.5.

Chemical acid treatment with HCl: soaking fresh GP in chemical agent concentrations of 6% and 10% w/w dry basis at ambient temperature (20 ± 1 °C) for 24 h with continuous shaking at 150 rpm, followed by neutralization to pH 7.5.

Pulsed Electric Fields (PEF) treatment: application of rectangular monopolar trains with a voltage of 3600 V cm-1 and pulse duration of 50 µs at frequencies between 24–240 Hz, with energy inputs of 41 kJ kg-1 (Z0.5) and 153 kJ kg-1 (Z1).

Ultrasounds (US) treatment: sonication at a frequency of 50 kHz and effective power output of 60 W for durations of 40 min (Z0.5) or 70 min (Z1), with energy inputs of 400 kJ kg-1 and 700 kJ kg-1 respectively.
Mechanical degradation via grinding: use of a blender (Waring blender 8011EG) at a speed of 22,000 rpm for 10 minutes to reduce particle size.
